card.name: "Of" before radiopharmaceutical names
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after dose, activity or administration, where a radioactive drug name comes next. It is seen in nuclear imaging agent labels such as technetium, rubidium and iodine products.

modes.label: Dose or administration of

modes.label: Amount of radioactivity
modes.description: "of" after a quantity such as microcuries or available activity, before an isotope name.
modes.example: intravenous injection of 50 microcuries<< of>> Iodinated I 131

card.writes: It pushes the model toward radio- and isotope words as the next word.
